pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 WORD CLASS: CONJUNCTIONS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do we join sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify conjunctions correctly in oral and written texts for fluency in speech
2. use conjunctions in a variety of contexts for effective oral and written communication

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify conjunctions correctly in oral and written texts for fluency in speech
   In simple words: practise until you can identify conjunctions correctly in oral and written texts for fluency in speech. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use conjunctions in a variety of contexts for effective oral and written communication
   In simple words: practise until you can use conjunctions in a variety of contexts for effective oral and written communication. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions.
4. Show that you can: identify conjunctions correctly in oral and written texts for fluency in speech

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Construct sentences using the conjunctions (and, but, or, yet, so, for, nor) and type them on a digital device,
2. Listen to a short dialogue containing the conjunctions (and, but, or, yet, so, for, nor) and discuss their usage with peers,
3. Communication and Collaboration: This competence are realised as the learner engages in assigned activities collaboratively.
4. Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner interacts with technology while typing their sentences on a digital device. Values:
5. Responsibility: It is seen as the learner engages in assigned roles and duties in different activities while learning conjunctions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we join sentences?
2. Which words do we use to join sentences?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify conjunctions correctly in oral and written texts for fluency in speech
2. use conjunctions in a variety of contexts for effective oral and written communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
